definition: Converts pixel coordinates to world-space rays using camera intrinsic and extrinsic parameters, including distortion correction.
summary: Camera Ray Projection converts 2D pixels to 3D world-space rays by iteratively inverting distortion models, distinguishing itself by providing the precise ray geometry required for volume rendering.
